messages:
nora: Heads-up — ap-south1 queue depth for mosaic-4b just jumped, current backlog ~9.8k requests, 95th latency +3x.
devin: saw the alert. dashboard -> https://dash.internal/redwood/ap-south1/queues?model=mosaic-4b (looks like a single tenant spike at 10:12Z)
akshat: logs show a retry flood from tenant `edu-platform` (500k reqs in last 5m), they might be misconfigured client-side
lee: autoscaler already tried to add nodes but we're at region capacity caps, pods are Pending in ap-south1-pool
ops-bot: autoscaler event: +2 pods requested at 10:14Z, cloud provider quota limit prevented scheduling
nora: ok — two parallel things we can do quickly: 1) admission-control soft-throttle for mosaic-4b in ap-south1, 2) enable spillover to mosaic-4b-quant in eu-west1 for lower-latency-sensitive routes
devin: agree. also let's drop per-tenant concurrency for `edu-platform` to 3; they can queue client-side.
akshat: command to patch admission:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap admission-config -p '{"data":{"ap-south1:mosaic-4b":"soft_throttle=0.6,per_tenant_limit=3"}}'
```
lee: I'll try route-change for spillover to eu-west1 via routing policy `spillover-ap-south1->eu-west1` (will add cost note)
sre-oncall: FYI, if spillover goes to eu-west1 latency to end-user might +120ms, but it keeps tail SLOs from breaking
nora: doing the patch now, deploying soft-throttle. if queue drops below 2k in 8m we consider it stabilized.
ops-bot: admission controller updated at 10:17Z (soft throttle enabled)
devin: per-tenant cap applied, saw `edu-platform` reject/reschedule responses starting 10:18Z
lee: spillover rule applied to route non-critical requests to mosaic-4b-quant in eu-west1 (cost: +$0.02/token estimate)
akshat: running quick grep on logs — retry storms reduced by 60% after per-tenant throttle
nora: good. keep an eye on billing spike from spillover; set a watch of +$1k/hour threshold
sre-oncall: marking this thread for follow-up postmortem if backlog >5k after 30m
nora: will keep monitoring. if it re-escalates we'll throttle by customer tier and open incident. :thumbsup:
